attrs.reason: Management states growth is driven by end-market demand and monitors DSO/inventory (E32, E37). Reported revenue growth of 35.7% (E13 vs E1) and the disclosed inventory build to support anticipated growth (E39) corroborate the demand narrative. The Beneish M-score flag (E31) is a known statistical artifact in high-growth firms and does not contradict the reported demand drivers.

rebuttal.innocent_explanation: The Beneish M-score flag is a false positive common in high-growth firms; the elevated SGI stems from 35.7% revenue growth and the elevated DSRI from receivables growing faster due to a shift toward complete systems sold to internet data center customers with longer payment terms, not from aggressive revenue recognition.

attrs.final_verdict: explanation does not fit the numbers
